The front face has two columns. Left column (narrow), from top to bottom: (1) one round white push button with a bright lime-green ring around it and a faint power symbol in its center; (2) one tiny red indicator dot just below the button; (3) four bright green USB-A ports stacked vertically close together, each a small horizontal rectangle; (4) one small gray oval USB-C port, the last item at the bottom of the left column. One single round white cable comes out of the top edge of the strip, above the sockets. No logo, no printed text, no other colors, no other ports, no other buttons on the strip.
